info.title: Octen API
info.description: Octen API provides Broad Search, Web Search, Image Search, Video Search, Extract, Embeddings, VL Embeddings, Answer, and Deep Research services. The Web Search API searches ranked web results with optional filters, highlights, and full content. The Image Search API searches for images from a text query or an image, with an optional design mode that returns a structured summary and a reusable HTML snippet for each result. The Video Search API searches for videos from a text query. The Broad Search API decomposes a query into multiple sub-queries, searches them in parallel, and returns results grouped by sub-query. The Extract API extracts clean content from URLs, with optional query-focused highlights, page classification, and multimedia resources. The Embeddings API converts text into vector representations. The VL Embeddings API converts multimodal inputs into vector representations. The Answer API decomposes queries into multiple sub-queries for comprehensive search and synthesis. The Deep Research API runs a multi-round adaptive research pipeline that produces a structured research plan, executes iterative searches, and streams a final long-form report.

post.description:
Generates a deep research report at the selected tier. The `pro-visual` tier also returns relevant images and videos.

**Two-phase invocation**
- **Phase 1:** the server generates a research plan. If the plan has no ambiguity, the server proceeds directly to research and streams the final report. If the plan is ambiguous, the `plan` event carries `requires_selection=true` together with a `plan_id`, and the SSE stream ends there — waiting for the client to confirm.
- **Phase 2:** call this endpoint again with the `plan_id` and `selections`. The server loads the stored plan, applies the selections, and streams the final report.

**Notes**
- Phase 2 only inherits the stored `plan` via `plan_id`. Other parameters are NOT inherited from Phase 1 — they must be supplied again in Phase 2, otherwise they fall back to defaults.
- `messages` is required in both phases and should carry the same user question.

ExtractResult.description: A single extraction result. Batch requests may return 200 OK overall while individual items fail; failed items are marked with `status: "failed"` and an `error_message`, and are not billed.

resolved_mode.description: The mode this URL is billed at. For `auto`, the mode chosen for this URL. Returned when `status` is `success`.

title.description: Page title, extracted from HTML `<title>` or `<meta>` tags.

full_content.description: Complete page content in the requested format. Returned when `query` is not provided.

highlights.description: Query-relevant snippets, sorted by relevance. Returned when `query` is provided.

time_last_crawled.description: Most recent time Octen crawled this URL, ISO 8601 format.

page_structure.description: Detected page structure. Returns `null` when the structure cannot be determined.

category.description: Detected content category. Returns `null` when the category cannot be determined.

favicon.description: The page's favicon URL. Returned by default when available.

cover_image.description: The page cover image. Returned only when `include_images` is `true` and the page has a cover image.

images.description: Image resources detected on the page. Returned when `include_images` is `true` and the page contains images.

videos.description: Video resources detected on the page. Returned when `include_videos` is `true` and the page contains videos.

audio.description: Audio resources detected on the page. Returned when `include_audio` is `true` and the page contains audio.

links.description: Links detected on the page, deduplicated. Returned for successful results when `include_links` is set and links are detected on the page.

error_message.description: Failure reason. Only present when `status` is `failed`. See the Error Codes reference for the complete list of result-level error messages.

ExtractPageStructure.description: Detected page structure for an extraction result.

secondary.description: Sub-type within the primary structure. 50+ possible values. `null` when no sub-type applies.

ExtractCategory.description: Detected content category for an extraction result.

secondary.description: Sub-category within the primary category. 160+ possible values. `null` when no sub-category applies.

ExtractMediaResource.description: A single multimedia resource detected on the page.

ExtractLink.description: A single link found on the page.

url.description: Absolute URL of the link target.

anchor_text.description: The link's visible text on the page. Empty when the link has no visible text.

is_external.description: Whether the link points to a different registered domain than the page.

ExtractMeta.description: Additional metadata for the extract request.

warning.description: Warning messages for the request, separated by semicolons. An empty string when there is nothing to report.

ExtractUsage.description: Usage and billing breakdown for the extract request.

total_urls.description: Total number of URLs in the request.

successful_urls.description: Number of successfully extracted URLs (billed). Failed URLs are not counted.

standard_urls.description: Successful URLs billed at the standard rate.

advanced_urls.description: Successful URLs billed at the advanced rate.

input.description: The text to be converted into embeddings. Maximum characters per element: 10000. Maximum request body size: 2MB

model.description: The embedding model used for this request. `octen-embedding-0.6b` (max dim: 1024) for cost/throughput priority; `octen-embedding-4b` (max dim: 2560) for most applications; `octen-embedding-8b` (max dim: 4096) for accuracy-critical tasks.

dimension.description: The dimensionality of the output embedding vectors. Defaults to the model's max dimension (0.6b: 1024, 4b: 2560, 8b: 4096). If set to a value smaller than the model default, the embedding will be truncated to the first N values. Any positive integer ≤ model default dimension is allowed.

input_type.description: Specifies whether the input is a query or a document for retrieval. Different values apply different internal prompts: `query` → "Represent the query for retrieving supporting" (prepended and counted in input_tokens); `document` and `null` mean no special prompt is applied.

request_id.description: The unique identifier for this request.

results.description: A list of embedding results. Each item corresponds to one input.

model.description: The embedding model used for this request.

index.description: The position of the embedding in the input array (useful when input is a list).

EmbeddingMeta.description: Additional metadata for the embedding request.

EmbeddingUsage.description: Usage information for the embedding request.

input_tokens.description: The number of input tokens processed in this request.

model.description: The multimodal embedding model used for this request.

enable_fusion.description: Whether to generate a fused embedding. When `true`, all elements in `contents` are fused into a single vector; when `false`, each element produces an independent vector.

dimension.description: The dimensionality of the output embedding vectors. Defaults to the model's max dimension (octen-vl-embedding: 2048, octen-vl-embedding-large: 4096). Any positive integer ≤ the model's max dimension is allowed.

fps.description: Frames sampled per second of video. For example, `0.5` samples one frame every two seconds. Lower values sample fewer frames and reduce video token consumption. Each video is sampled to at most 64 frames.

instruct.description: Custom task description used to guide the model in understanding the query intent. Its length counts toward `input_tokens` and shares the 10,000-character total limit with `contents`.

VLEmbeddingInput.description: The multimodal content to be vectorized. Supports text, images, videos, and combinations. Maximum total elements per request: 20. Maximum images per request: 5. Maximum videos per request: 1.

contents.description: The list of content elements to process.

VLEmbeddingContent.description: A single content element. Each object should provide exactly one of `text`, `image`, or `video`. For multiple images, include multiple content objects (one image per object).

text.description: Text input. Maximum 10,000 characters per entry.

image.description: Image input. Supports a URL or a Base64 string. Maximum 5MB per image. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WEBP, BMP, TIFF, ICO, DIB, ICNS, SGI.

video.description: Video input. URL only. Maximum 50MB per file. Supported formats: MP4, AVI, MOV.

request_id.description: The unique identifier for this request.

VLEmbeddingData.description: The main VL embedding response payload.

model.description: The embedding model used for this request.

index.description: The position of the embedding in the input array.

embedding.description: The generated embedding vector. Type and encoding may vary based on the input parameters.

VLEmbeddingMeta.description: Additional metadata for the VL embedding request.

VLEmbeddingUsage.description: Usage information for the VL embedding request.

input_tokens.description: Total number of input tokens processed in this request.

text_tokens.description: Number of tokens consumed by text inputs.

image_tokens.description: Total tokens consumed by image and video inputs (videos are sampled into frames before counting).

image_count.description: Number of images in the request (excluding frames extracted from videos).

duration.description: Total duration of video inputs in seconds.

code.description: Business status code. Non-zero values indicate an error.

ChatCompletionRequest.description: Request body for the Chat Completions API. Some parameters apply only to certain models; unsupported parameters are ignored for the selected model.

model.description: The model to use for chat completion.

messages.description: The conversation so far. System prompt plus user and assistant messages in chronological order.

tool_choice.description: Controls tool invocation. `none`: never call tools; `auto`: model decides (default); `required`: must call a tool. Can also be an object to force a specific tool. Only valid when `tools` is set.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether the model may issue multiple tool calls in one reply. When `false`, at most one tool call per turn.

stream.description: Whether to enable streaming output. When `true`, returns `chat.completion.chunk` objects incrementally.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens the model can output. If not set, the model's internal default limit is used.

max_completion_tokens.description: Maximum completion tokens, including reasoning and visible output tokens. If not set, the model's internal default limit is used.

temperature.description: Controls randomness in generation. Higher values produce more diverse output; lower values produce more deterministic output.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling. Only tokens with cumulative probability up to `top_p` are considered.

top_k.description: Sample only from the top K most probable tokens. `0` disables it.

min_p.description: Minimum probability threshold relative to the most probable token. Tokens below it are filtered out. `0` disables it.

top_a.description: Dynamic filtering threshold based on the most probable token. `0` disables it.

repetition_penalty.description: Penalizes tokens already present in the input. Above 1 suppresses repetition; below 1 encourages it.

frequency_penalty.description: Penalizes tokens by their frequency in the output so far. Positive values reduce repetition.

presence_penalty.description: Penalizes tokens that have already appeared. Positive values encourage new topics.

stop.description: Stop sequences. Generation stops when any of these strings is encountered.

seed.description: Seed for reproducibility. With the same parameters and model version, output should be as consistent as possible.

reasoning_effort.description: Top-level alias for `reasoning.effort`. If both are set, `reasoning` takes precedence.

verbosity.description: Controls how verbose the reply is.

logit_bias.description: A JSON object mapping token IDs to bias values (-100 to 100), added to the logits before sampling.

logprobs.description: Whether to return the log probabilities of the output tokens.

top_logprobs.description: Number of most likely tokens to return at each position. Requires `logprobs` to be `true`.

user.description: A unique identifier for the end user. Use hashed or pseudonymous identifiers to avoid passing personally identifiable information.

mode.description: `implicit` caches automatically; `explicit` caches only prefixes marked with a cache breakpoint.

ttl.description: How long a cache entry is retained.

previous_response_id.description: The `id` of a previous response, used to chain state across turns.

role.description: The role of the message author. Always `system`.

content.description: The system prompt content. A plain string or an array of content blocks.

role.description: The role of the message author. Always `user`.

content.description: The content of the message. A plain string or an array of content blocks.

role.description: The role of the message author. Always `assistant`.

content.description: The assistant's text content. May be `null` or omitted when the assistant only produces tool calls.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls generated by the model in a previous turn, replayed verbatim. Only valid when `role` is `assistant`.

role.description: The role of the message author. Always `tool`.

tool_call_id.description: The ID of the tool call this message responds to.

content.description: The tool output, typically a JSON string with the function result.

ChatToolCall.description: A custom function call generated by the model.

index.description: The index of this tool call in the array.

id.description: A unique identifier for this tool call. Referenced by the corresponding `tool` message's `tool_call_id`.

type.description: The type of tool call. Always `function`.

ChatToolCallFunction.description: The function invocation details within a tool call.

name.description: The name of the function to call.

arguments.description: The arguments to the function, as a JSON string generated by the model.

ChatContentBlock.description: A content block within a message.

text.description: The text content. Required when `type` is `text`.

image_url.description: Image URL object. Required when `type` is `image_url`.

ChatResponseFormat.description: Controls the output format. Some models may not support structured output and will automatically fall back to `text`.

ChatReasoningOptions.description: Options for reasoning models. Turns thinking on or off and sets the effort and budget.

enabled.description: Set to `false` to turn off thinking. Overrides `effort` and `max_tokens`.

ChatFunctionTool.description: A custom function tool, executed by the caller.

type.description: The type of tool. Always `function` for a custom tool.

ChatOctenBroadSearchTool.description: The built-in `octen_broad_search` server tool, executed by Octen.

ChatOctenSearchTool.description: The built-in `octen_search` server tool, executed by Octen.

ChatToolDefinition.description: A tool definition. One of a custom `function` tool, the built-in `octen_broad_search` tool, or the `octen_search` tool.

description.description: A description of what the function does.

parameters.description: The function's parameter definition in JSON Schema format.

strict.description: Whether to enable strict mode. When enabled, generated arguments strictly conform to `parameters`.

ChatCompletionResponse.description: A non-streaming chat completion response. Returned when `stream=false`.

id.description: The unique identifier for this request.

object.description: The object type, always `chat.completion` for non-streaming responses.

created.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the completion was created.

model.description: The model used for this completion.

search_results.description: Search results. Present only when `octen_search` was actually triggered.

ChatCompletionChoice.description: A single completion choice in a non-streaming response.

index.description: The index of this choice. Usually 0.

finish_reason.description: The reason the model stopped generating. `stop` indicates normal completion.

role.description: The role of the message author. Always `assistant`.

content.description: The assistant's text content. May be `null` when the model only produces tool calls or refuses.

tool_calls.description: Custom function calls generated by the model. Present only when `finish_reason` is `tool_calls`.

annotations.description: Citation annotations. Present only when `octen_broad_search` or `octen_search` was used.

reasoning.description: Reasoning text. Present only for reasoning models, otherwise `null`.

reasoning_details.description: Detailed reasoning information. Present only for reasoning models.

ChatCompletionUsage.description: Token usage information. When `stream=true`, returned only in the final `usage` chunk.

num_search_queries.description: Number of searches executed. Returned only when search was used.

full_content_extra_count.description: Billable full_content results beyond the free allowance. Returned only when `full_content` is enabled.

prompt_tokens.description: Number of input tokens. Cache read and write tokens are included here, not listed separately.

completion_tokens.description: Number of output tokens (reasoning tokens are included).

prompt_tokens_details.description: Breakdown of input tokens. Returned only when the prompt cache is hit or written to.

cached_tokens.description: Portion of `prompt_tokens` served from cache (a subset of `prompt_tokens`).

cache_write_tokens.description: Tokens written to cache (a subset of `prompt_tokens`). Returned only when `cache_control` was used and the model supports cache writes.

cache_write_5m_tokens.description: Tokens written to the 5-minute cache (a subset of `cache_write_tokens`). Only the field matching the TTL used is returned.

cache_write_1h_tokens.description: Tokens written to the 1-hour cache (a subset of `cache_write_tokens`). Only the field matching the TTL used is returned.

completion_tokens_details.description: Breakdown of output tokens. Returned only for reasoning models.

reasoning_tokens.description: Number of reasoning tokens (already included in `completion_tokens`).

ChatCompletionChunk.description: A streaming chunk. Returned when `stream=true`. The `type` field indicates the chunk kind: `search_done`, `content`, `finish`, `usage`. After the last chunk, `data: [DONE]` is sent.

type.description: The type of this streaming chunk.

id.description: The unique identifier for this request.

object.description: The object type, always `chat.completion.chunk` for streaming responses.

created.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the chunk was created.

model.description: The model used for this completion.

choices.description: Incremental choices. Present in `content` and `finish` chunks.

ChatCompletionChunkChoice.description: A single choice in a streaming chunk.

index.description: The index of this choice. Usually 0.

finish_reason.description: The reason generation stopped. `null` for intermediate chunks; set in the `finish` chunk.

ChatCompletionDelta.description: Incremental content in a streaming chunk. Contains only the new fields for this chunk.

role.description: The role. Typically included in the first chunk.

ChatToolCallDelta.description: Incremental tool call data in a streaming chunk. The first chunk for a tool call includes `id`, `type`, and `function.name`. Subsequent chunks append to `function.arguments`.

index.description: The index of this tool call in the tool_calls array.

id.description: The tool call ID. Only present in the first chunk for this tool call.

name.description: The function name. Only present in the first chunk for this tool call.

arguments.description: Incremental JSON string of the function arguments. Concatenate across chunks to build the complete arguments.

ChatToolChoiceObject.description: Forces a specific tool. The named tool must be declared in `tools`.

type.description: The type of tool to force.

function.description: The function to call. Required when `type` is `function`.

name.description: The name of the function to call.

ChatJsonSchemaSpec.description: JSON Schema specification for structured output. Required when `response_format.type` is `json_schema`.

name.description: A user-defined name for the schema.

strict.description: Whether the model output must strictly conform to the schema.

schema.description: The JSON Schema definition object. May contain `type`, `properties`, `required`, `additionalProperties`, etc.

AnswerRequest.description: Request body for the Answer API.

model.description: The model to use for query decomposition and response synthesis.

messages.description: A list of messages comprising the conversation so far. User and assistant messages in chronological order for multi-turn conversations.

mode.description: Controls the execution depth. `queries_only`: only decompose the message into sub-queries without performing searches; `queries_and_search`: decompose into sub-queries and return search results without LLM synthesis; `full`: decompose, search, and synthesize a final response using the LLM.

max_queries.description: Maximum number of sub-queries to generate.

web_search_options.description: Search options. Shares the same parameters and defaults as the Web Search API, except `highlight.max_tokens` defaults to 256. Queries are automatically generated from the messages.

stream.description: Whether to enable streaming output. When `true`, returns `chat.completion.chunk` objects incrementally with types: `queries`, `search_done`, `content`, `finish`, and `usage`.

AnswerResponse.description: A non-streaming Answer response. Returned when `stream=false`.

request_id.description: The unique identifier for this request.

object.description: The object type, always `chat.completion` for non-streaming responses.

created.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the completion was created.

model.description: The model used for this completion.

choices.description: A list of completion choices containing the synthesized response.

queries.description: The list of sub-queries automatically generated from the user message by the system.

search_results.description: Search results grouped by query. Each sub-query has a corresponding result group.

SearchResultGroup.description: A group of search results for a single sub-query.

query.description: The sub-query that produced these results.

results.description: The search results for this sub-query.

latency.description: Search latency for this query in milliseconds.

SynthesisUsage.description: Token usage information for the Answer response. When `stream=true`, this is only present in the `usage` type chunk.

num_search_queries.description: Total number of search queries executed across all sub-queries.

AnswerChunk.description: A streaming chunk of an Answer response. Returned when `stream=true`. The `type` field indicates the chunk kind: `queries`, `search_done`, `content`, `finish`, `usage`.

type.description: The type of this streaming chunk. The `queries` type contains the auto-generated sub-queries.

request_id.description: The unique identifier for this request.

object.description: The object type, always `chat.completion.chunk` for streaming responses.

created.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the chunk was created.

model.description: The model used for this completion.

queries.description: Auto-generated sub-queries. Present only in `queries` type chunks.

choices.description: Incremental choices. Present in `content` and `finish` chunks.

search_results.description: Search results grouped by query. Present in `search_done` chunks.

DeepResearchRequest.description: Request body for the Deep Research API.

tier.description: The research tier. `lite`, `standard`, and `pro` increase research depth, cost, and time in that order. `pro-visual` additionally illustrates each report section with images and videos and streams an HTML version of the report.

messages.description: Conversation messages. Only the last `role=user` message is used as the research question; other messages are ignored and do not enter plan generation, search, analysis, or report writing.

extra_context.description: Additional research background, constraints, or preferences, used as extra context for query rewriting and research direction supplementation.

skip_brief.description:
Skip the Research Brief stage and write the final report directly from raw search and analysis results.

Note: when enabled, no `brief` event is emitted. Clients can rebuild the citation index by accumulating `search_results` events in the order they arrive (round-by-round / query-by-query / result-by-result) into a global index, then look up the corresponding url/title by the `N` in `[^N]`.

skip_plan.description: Phase 1 only. Skip the Research Plan stage and proceed straight to the search loop. With `skip_plan=true`, the call never enters the Phase 2 pause mechanism.

skip_plan_confirm.description: Phase 1 only. When `true`, the run continues with all angles even if the plan is ambiguous, instead of pausing and waiting for the user to confirm a selection.

plan_id.description: Phase 2 only. The plan ID returned by a Phase 1 `plan` event with `requires_selection=true`. When provided, the server skips plan generation and applies the supplied `selections` against the stored plan. Each `plan_id` is retained for 30 minutes; after expiry the plan is regenerated.

selections.description: Phase 2 only. The user's corrections and angle filtering against the Phase 1 plan.

DeepResearchMessage.description: A single message in the Deep Research request.

role.description: The role of the message author.

content.description: The content of the message. Can be a plain string, or an array of text content blocks.

type.description: The block type. Always `text` for Deep Research.

DeepResearchSelection.description: A single user correction or angle filter applied against a Phase 1 plan.

term.description: An ambiguous term, matching `plan.interpretations[].term`. When present, overrides the LLM's default `chosen` meaning.

chosen.description: The selected meaning ID (from `plan.interpretations[].meanings[].id`, e.g. `"nasa_program"`). Pass `"all"` to keep every meaning. When used as an angle filter, this carries the `interpretation_id` of the angles to keep.

indices.description: 0-based angle indices within the group identified by `chosen`. Absent means keep every angle in that group.

DeepResearchChunk.description: A streaming chunk of a Deep Research response.

type.description: The type of this streaming chunk. On the `pro-visual` tier, `html_delta` chunks stream an HTML version of the report after the report content completes, and a final `html` chunk marks the end of that stream.

request_id.description: The unique identifier for this request.

created.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the chunk was created.

round.description: Current research round. Present only in `queries`, `search_done`, and `analysis` chunks.

latency.description: Latency in milliseconds for the stage represented by this chunk.

status.description: Pipeline progress copy. Present only in `status` chunks.

plan_id.description: Plan ID carried by `plan` chunks. The client must echo this back as `plan_id` when entering Phase 2.

queries.description: Sub-queries generated for this round. Present only in `queries` chunks.

search_result_count.description: Total number of search results returned this round. Present only in `search_done` chunks.

search_results.description: Search results for this round, one group per sub-query. Present only in `search_done` chunks.

choices.description: Incremental choices for the final report. Present in `content` and `finish` chunks.

visual.description: Visual material for one report section. Present only in `visual` chunks, emitted on the `pro-visual` tier.

html_delta.description: An incremental fragment of the HTML report. Present only in `html_delta` chunks. Concatenate the fragments in order to rebuild the full page.

delta.description: The next fragment of the HTML page.

DeepResearchPlan.description: Research plan generated in Phase 1. Carried by `plan` chunks.

interpretations.description: Ambiguous terms in the question along with their possible meanings. Empty when the question has no ambiguity.

angles.description: Research angles the plan will explore.

requires_selection.description: When `true`, the SSE stream ends at this `plan` chunk and waits for the client to continue via Phase 2 (`plan_id` + `selections`). When `false`, research continues automatically.

DeepResearchInterpretation.description: An ambiguous term and its candidate meanings.

meanings.description: All candidate meanings for this term.

chosen.description: The meaning ID the LLM picked by default.

reasoning.description: The LLM's rationale for the chosen meaning.

DeepResearchMeaning.description: A candidate meaning for an ambiguous term.

DeepResearchAngle.description: A single research angle within the plan.

interpretation_id.description: The meaning ID this angle serves. `"general"` denotes a cross-interpretation angle.

queries.description: Search queries planned for this angle.

sub_question_ids.description: Sub-question IDs covered by this angle.

DeepResearchAnalysis.description: Analysis output for one research round. Carried by `analysis` chunks.

findings.description: Key findings extracted from this round.

should_continue.description: Whether the pipeline should run another research round.

follow_up_suggestions.description: Suggested research directions for the next round.

DeepResearchBrief.description: Report outline and evidence set. Carried by `brief` chunks.

report_type.description: Report type, classified by the LLM from the question. `general`: general synthesis; `comparison`: cross-entity comparison; `trend`: time-axis trend analysis; `how-to`: step-by-step guide; `evaluation`: ranked or scored evaluation; `framework`: methodology or scoring framework; `deep_explainer`: deep explanation of a single topic; `theoretical_analysis`: scholarly analysis across multiple theoretical lenses; `landscape_mapping`: taxonomy and players in a domain; `multi_part`: composite question with explicit sub-questions.

secondary_report_types.description: Secondary type tags for hybrid reports, combined with `report_type`.

total_word_budget.description: Total word budget for the report.

assertiveness_required.description: Whether the report must deliver a clear verdict.

tables.description: Table metadata to render in the report. Mutually exclusive with `presentation_notes`.

presentation_notes.description: Presentation notes for reports that do not use tables. Mutually exclusive with `tables`.

sub_question_to_section_map.description: Mapping from sub-question ID to section ID.

DeepResearchVerdictScaffold.description: Structured scaffold for reports that need to deliver a verdict.

verdict_type.description: Shape of the verdict. `ranked_list`: ordered ranking; `single_pick`: a single best answer; `tiered_recommendation`: tiered recommendation; `qualified_pick`: conditional recommendation.

items_expected.description: Expected number of items in the verdict.

DeepResearchTable.description: Table metadata referenced from an outline section.

description.description: Description of the table contents, guiding how the report-writing stage should populate the cells.

placement.description: Section ID this table belongs to.

DeepResearchOutlineSection.description: A single section in the report outline.

section_id.description: Unique section ID, referenced by `sub_question_to_section_map` and `table.placement`.

table_ids.description: Table IDs belonging to this section.

covers_sub_questions.description: Sub-question IDs covered by this section.

target_words.description: Target word count for this section.

DeepResearchEvidence.description: A single piece of evidence within a section.

source_indices.description: Source indices cited by this evidence (matching `brief.references[].index`).

DeepResearchUnresolved.description: Items the brief stage flagged as unresolved.

index.description: Reference index; cited in the report body as `[^N]`.

DeepResearchVisual.description: Visual material for one report section. Carried by `visual` chunks on the `pro-visual` tier.

section_id.description: The report section this material belongs to, matching `brief.outline[].section_id`.

DeepResearchVisualImage.description: An image selected for a report section.

caption.description: A short caption for the image.

visual_evidence.description: Why this image supports the section's content.

source_page.description: URL of the page the image was found on.

DeepResearchVisualVideo.description: A video selected for a report section.

source_page.description: URL of the page the video was found on.

DeepResearchMeta.description: Usage and latency metadata for the Deep Research call. Carried by `usage` chunks.

num_search_queries.description: Total number of search queries executed across all rounds.

total_rounds.description: Total number of research rounds completed.

total_search_count.description: Total search results accumulated across all rounds.

billed_tier.description: The tier actually billed for this request.

DeepResearchChunkChoice.description: A single choice in a Deep Research streaming chunk. Carried by `content` and `finish` chunks.

index.description: The index of this choice. Usually `0`.

finish_reason.description: The reason generation stopped. `null` in `content` chunks; populated in the `finish` chunk.

DeepResearchChunkDelta.description: Incremental content in a Deep Research streaming chunk.

content.description: Incremental report text. Concatenate across `content` chunks to build the final report.

HtmlSnippetOptions.description: Only effective when `topic=design`; controls whether an `html_snippet` is returned for each result.

enable.description: If `true`, returns an `html_snippet` for each image result.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens of `html_snippet` returned per image result.

ImageSearchInput.description: A single multimodal input. Currently each request accepts exactly one input: either one text input or one image input.

type.description: The input type. A single image must be at most 5MB and one of: JPEG, PNG, WEBP, BMP, TIFF, ICO, DIB, ICNS, SGI.

url.description: Image input as a public URL. For an image input, provide either `url` or `data`, not both.

data.description: When `type` is `text`: the query content, max 500 characters. When `type` is `image`: base64-encoded image data, at most 5MB after encoding.

ImageSearchRequest.description: Request body for the Image Search API.

inputs.description: Multimodal input array. Currently only a single input is supported: either one text input or one image input.

topic.description: Use `general` for general image search, or `design` for design reference.

include_domains.description: Domains to include, matched against each result's `source_page` URL.

exclude_domains.description: Domains to exclude, matched against each result's `source_page` URL.

safesearch.description: Controls filtering of explicit/adult content. `off` disables filtering; `strict` drops all adult content.

html_snippet.description: Only effective when `topic=design`; controls whether an `html_snippet` is returned for each result.

source_page.description: URL of the original page hosting the image.

description.description: Server-generated text description of the image content.

summary.description: Structured description of the design asset, covering category, layout, style, tags, and more. Returned only when `topic=design`.

html_snippet.description: HTML/CSS snippet that an LLM can reuse directly. Returned only when `topic=design` and `html_snippet.enable` is `true`.

ImageSearchUsage.description: Usage information for the Image Search request.

ImageSearchMeta.description: Additional metadata for the Image Search request.

results.description: A list of image search results.

request_id.description: The unique identifier for this request.

VideoSearchInput.description: A single text input. At most one input per request.

VideoSearchRequest.description: Request body for the Video Search API.

inputs.description: Input array carrying a text query (at most 1).

time_range.description: Relative time window counting back from the current time, filtered by publish time. Mutually exclusive with `start_time`/`end_time` — if both are provided, `start_time`/`end_time` take precedence.

start_time.description: Start time for filtering results by publish time. ISO 8601 format.

end_time.description: End time for filtering results by publish time. ISO 8601 format.

safesearch.description: Controls filtering of explicit/adult content. `off` disables filtering; `strict` drops all adult content.

source_page.description: URL of the original page hosting the video.

description.description: Server-generated text description of the video content.

VideoSearchUsage.description: Usage information for the Video Search request.

VideoSearchMeta.description: Additional metadata for the Video Search request.

results.description: A list of video search results.

request_id.description: The unique identifier for this request.

OpenAIErrorResponse.description: Error body in the OpenAI protocol format.

message.description: A human-readable description of the error.

param.description: The parameter related to the error, if any.

code.description: A machine-readable error code, if any.

AnthropicErrorResponse.description: Error body in the Anthropic protocol format.

message.description: A human-readable description of the error.

include_domains.description: A list of domains to specifically include in the search results. The `site:` query operator adds to this list.

exclude_domains.description: A list of domains to specifically exclude from the search results. The `-site:` query operator adds to this list. If a domain appears in both `include_domains` and `exclude_domains`, `exclude_domains` takes precedence.

include_text.description: Strings that must appear in the result page text.

exclude_text.description: Strings that must not appear in the result page text.

time_basis.description: Determines which time field is used for time filtering. `published` uses time_published; `crawled` uses time_last_crawled. Results missing this field are excluded when filtering by time.

time_range.description: Relative time window counting back from the current time based on `time_basis`. Mutually exclusive with `start_time`/`end_time` — if both are provided, `start_time`/`end_time` take precedence.

start_time.description: Start time for filtering results. ISO 8601 format.

end_time.description: End time for filtering results. ISO 8601 format.

language.description: A list of languages to restrict results to, as ISO 639-1 codes. By default, no language filter is applied.

format.description: Controls the formatting of highlight outputs.

safesearch.description: Controls filtering of explicit/adult content. `off` disables filtering; `strict` drops all adult content.

include_images.description: Whether to include images in each result.

OctenBroadSearchToolParameters.description: Behavior configuration for the built-in `octen_broad_search` tool. Identical to `octen_search` except it accepts `max_queries` instead of `max_searches`. All parameters are optional and share the same semantics and defaults as the Web Search API.

max_queries.description: Upper bound on the number of sub-queries generated.

OctenSearchToolParameters.description: Behavior configuration for the built-in `octen_search` tool. All parameters are optional and share the same semantics and defaults as the Web Search API. The query is generated automatically by the model; a single request may trigger multiple searches.

max_searches.description: Maximum number of searches allowed in a single request.

CacheControl.description: Prompt caching marker. Sets a cache breakpoint so the stable prefix up to this block can be reused.

DeveloperMessage.description: A developer message. The OpenAI-protocol equivalent of `system` (sent by newer OpenAI SDKs); handled as `system`.

role.description: The role of the message author. Always `developer`.

content.description: The content. A plain string or an array of content blocks.

ChatAnnotation.description: A citation annotation. Returned only when `octen_search` was used, currently only for `anthropic/` models. For other models, results are still available in `search_results`.

url.description: The URL of the cited source.

title.description: The title of the cited source.

start_index.description: Start position of the cited span in `content`.

end_index.description: End position of the cited span in `content`.

ChatReasoningDetail.description: Detailed reasoning information. Returned only for reasoning models.

format.description: The format of the reasoning information.

index.description: The position of this entry in the output. Usually 0.

text.description: Reasoning text. Present only when `type` is `reasoning.text`.

summary.description: Reasoning summary. Present only when `type` is `reasoning.summary`.

data.description: Encrypted reasoning. Present only when `type` is `reasoning.encrypted`.

ChatLogprobs.description: Log probability information for the output tokens. Present only when `logprobs` is `true`, otherwise `null`.

logprob.description: The log probability of this token.

top_logprobs.description: The top candidate tokens at this position, same structure.

title.description: The title of the result page.

url.description: The URL of the result page.

highlights.description: Query-relevant highlight snippets. Returned only if `highlight.enable` is true.

full_content.description: Full raw page content. Returned only if `full_content.enable` is true.

ChatSearchResultGroup.description: Search results for a single auto-generated query. One element per search.

query.description: The query the model actually searched for. One message may produce multiple queries.

results.description: The search results for this query.

MessagesContentBlock.description: A content block within a message. The fields used depend on `type`. For replaying a multi-turn conversation, blocks such as `tool_use`, `tool_result`, `thinking`, `redacted_thinking`, `server_tool_use`, and `web_search_tool_result` are returned verbatim.

media_type.description: Image MIME type. Required when `source.type` is `base64`.

id.description: Block id, replayed verbatim. Used by `tool_use` and `server_tool_use` blocks.

name.description: Tool name, replayed verbatim. For `server_tool_use` it is `octen_search`. Used by `tool_use` and `server_tool_use` blocks.

input.description: Tool call arguments, replayed verbatim. Used by `tool_use` and `server_tool_use` blocks.

tool_use_id.description: The id of the corresponding `tool_use` or `server_tool_use` block. Used by `tool_result` and `web_search_tool_result` blocks.

content.description: Result content. A string or content blocks for `tool_result`; the array of `web_search_result` blocks for `web_search_tool_result`.

is_error.description: Whether the tool execution failed. Used by `tool_result` blocks.

thinking.description: Thinking content, replayed verbatim. Required when `type` is `thinking`.

signature.description: Thinking signature, replayed verbatim. Required when `type` is `thinking`.

data.description: Encrypted thinking content, replayed verbatim. Required when `type` is `redacted_thinking`.

MessagesMessage.description: A message in the conversation. Tool results are returned via a `tool_result` content block in a `user` message.

role.description: The role of the message author.

content.description: The content. A plain string or an array of content blocks.

MessagesCustomTool.description: A custom tool, executed by the caller and returned via a `tool_result` block.

description.description: A description of what the custom tool does.

input_schema.description: The custom tool's parameter definition in JSON Schema format.

strict.description: Whether to enable strict mode for a custom tool.

MessagesOctenBroadSearchTool.description: The built-in `octen_broad_search` server tool, executed by Octen.

MessagesOctenSearchTool.description: The built-in `octen_search` server tool, executed by Octen.

MessagesToolDefinition.description: A tool definition. One of a custom tool, the built-in `octen_broad_search` tool, or the `octen_search` tool.

MessagesToolChoice.description: Controls whether and how the model calls tools.

type.description: `auto`: model decides; `any`: must call a tool; `tool`: call a specific tool; `none`: no tools.

name.description: The tool name to force. Required when `type` is `tool` (e.g. `octen_broad_search` or `octen_search`).

disable_parallel_tool_use.description: When `true`, the model issues at most one tool call per turn.

type.description: `adaptive` lets the model decide the thinking depth.

budget_tokens.description: Thinking token budget. Required when `type` is `enabled`; must be less than `max_tokens`. Not allowed when `type` is `adaptive` or `disabled`.

display.description: Controls how thinking is shown. `summarized` returns thinking blocks; `omitted` returns only the signature so blocks can be replayed. Valid only when `type` is `enabled` or `adaptive`.

MessagesRequest.description: Request body for the Messages API. Some parameters apply only to certain models; unsupported parameters are ignored.

model.description: The model to use. Anthropic models also accept their native ids (e.g. `claude-opus-4-8`), which map to `anthropic/claude-opus-4.8`.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate, including thinking and visible output tokens.

messages.description: The conversation so far, in chronological order.

system.description: System prompt. A plain string or an array of text blocks supporting `cache_control`.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling. If unset, no nucleus truncation is applied. Set only one of `temperature` and `top_p`.

top_k.description: Sample only from the top K tokens. If unset, top-k filtering is disabled.

user_id.description: A unique identifier for the end user. Use hashed or pseudonymous identifiers to avoid passing personally identifiable information.

output_config.description: Controls how the model produces its output.

format.description: Structured output. Constrains the model to return content matching a JSON Schema.

schema.description: The JSON Schema the output must conform to.

cache_control.description: Top-level prompt caching marker. Sets a cache breakpoint on the last cacheable content block in the request, equivalent to setting `cache_control` on that block directly.

MessagesCitation.description: A citation into a search result. Returned only when `octen_search` was used and the text cites a result.

url.description: The URL of the cited source.

title.description: The title of the cited source.

encrypted_index.description: Encrypted index of the citation location. Replay verbatim when returning text blocks with citations.

title.description: The title of the result page.

url.description: The URL of the result page.

highlights.description: Query-relevant highlight snippets. Returned only if `highlight.enable` is true.

full_content.description: Full raw page content. Returned only if `full_content.enable` is true.

MessagesResponseContentBlock.description: A content block in the response. The fields present depend on `type`.

text.description: The assistant's text content. Present when `type` is `text`.

citations.description: Citation annotations for this text block. Present only when `octen_broad_search` or `octen_search` was used.

signature.description: Signature of the thinking block. Replay verbatim in multi-turn conversations.

data.description: Encrypted thinking content. Present when `type` is `redacted_thinking`.

id.description: Block id. Present for `tool_use` and `server_tool_use` blocks.

name.description: Tool name. Present for `tool_use` and `server_tool_use` blocks.

input.description: Tool call arguments. For `server_tool_use`, contains the auto-generated `query`.

tool_use_id.description: The id of the matching `server_tool_use` block. Present for `web_search_tool_result` blocks.

output_tokens.description: Number of output tokens (thinking tokens are included).

cache_creation_input_tokens.description: Tokens written to the prompt cache. Returned only when `cache_control` was used and the model supports caching.

cache_read_input_tokens.description: Tokens read from the prompt cache. Returned only when `cache_control` was used and the model supports caching.

cache_creation.description: Cache writes broken down by cache lifetime (a breakdown of `cache_creation_input_tokens`). Returned only when this call wrote to the cache.

output_tokens_details.description: Breakdown of output tokens. Returned only for reasoning models.

thinking_tokens.description: Number of thinking tokens (already included in `output_tokens`).

server_tool_use.description: Built-in tool usage. Returned only when a built-in tool was used.

web_search_requests.description: Number of searches executed, used for search billing.

full_content_extra_count.description: Billable full_content results beyond the free allowance. Returned only when `full_content` is enabled.

id.description: The unique identifier for this request.

model.description: The model used for this response.

content.description: The response content, as a list of content blocks.

stop_details.description: Additional detail about why the model stopped. Returned only when `stop_reason` is `refusal`.

explanation.description: An explanation of why the request was refused.

stop_sequence.description: The stop sequence that was hit, or `null`.

MessagesStreamEvent.description: A streaming SSE event. Returned when `stream=true`. Events arrive in order: `message_start` → `content_block_start`/`content_block_delta`/`content_block_stop` → `message_delta` → `message_stop`. `ping` may appear anywhere and can be ignored. On error, an `error` event is sent.

message.description: Present in `message_start`. The initial message (id, model, role, initial usage).

index.description: Present in `content_block_*`. The content block index; concatenate deltas by index.

content_block.description: Present in `content_block_start`. The block that is starting. For built-in search, the `web_search_tool_result` block carries the full results here.

usage.description: Present in `message_delta`. Cumulative token counts (not incremental).

ImageGenerationBaseRequest.description: Shared parameters for the Image Generation API. Text-to-image when no image is provided; image editing when an image is provided. Parameters marked (GPT only) or (Gemini only) apply only to those model families; unsupported parameters are ignored.

model.description: The model to use. Aliases `nano-banana-pro` (= `google/gemini-3-pro-image`) and `nano-banana-2` (= `google/gemini-3.1-flash-image`) are also accepted.

prompt.description: The text description for the model. The length limit is set by the model.

n.description: (GPT only) Number of images to generate. For Gemini, request multiple images in the `prompt` instead.

size.description: Output size as `width x height` (e.g. `1024x1024`) or `auto`.

output_format.description: Output image format. GPT supports png/jpeg/webp; Gemini supports png/jpeg (webp falls back to png).

output_compression.description: (GPT only) Compression level (percent). Effective only when `output_format` is jpeg or webp.

response_modalities.description: (Gemini only) Controls returned modalities. `["text","image"]` returns the image plus accompanying text; `["image"]` returns only the image.

media_resolution.description: (Gemini only) Processing resolution for input reference images.

stream.description: (GPT only) Whether to stream the response.

partial_images.description: (GPT only) Number of intermediate preview images to stream. Effective only when `stream=true`. Each preview costs an extra 100 image output tokens.

user.description: A unique identifier for the end user. Use hashed or pseudonymous identifiers to avoid passing personally identifiable information.

ImageGenerationRequest.description: JSON request body for the Image Generation API.

image.description: Reference/source image(s) for editing, a data URL prefix or a raw base64 string. Providing an image enters edit mode. An array passes multiple reference images.

mask.description: (GPT only) Mask image, base64-encoded PNG matching the input size. Transparent areas are repainted. Effective only when `image` is provided.

ImagePart.description: An ordered content part preserving the original text/image interleaving.

index.description: Index into the `data` array. Present when `type` is `image`; read the image bytes from `data[index].b64_json`.

input_tokens.description: Input tokens (text prompt + input image tokens).

output_tokens.description: Output tokens (generated image tokens + reasoning text tokens).

text_tokens.description: Output tokens used by reasoning text.

ImageGenerationResponse.description: A non-streaming image response. Images are always returned as base64.

id.description: The unique identifier for this request.

created.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the request was created.

background.description: (GPT only) The background setting actually applied.

output_format.description: The output format actually applied; for Gemini, derived from the mimeType.

quality.description: (GPT only) The quality tier actually applied.

size.description: (GPT only) The output size actually applied; useful when `size` was `auto`.

data.description: The generated images, one element per image.

text.description: (Gemini only) Plain-text summary of text the model produced alongside the image. For exact interleaving, read `parts`.

parts.description: (Gemini only) Content parts in the model's original order, preserving text/image interleaving.

ImageGenerationStreamEvent.description: A streaming SSE event. Partial preview images arrive first (each with `partial_image_index`), then one `completed` event with `usage`. The event type prefix is `image_generation` for text-to-image and `image_edit` for editing.

id.description: Request identifier. Identical across all events of one request.

b64_json.description: Base64 image for this event: the current preview for `partial_image`, the final image for `completed`.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp when the event was generated.

size.description: (GPT only) The output size actually applied; useful when `size` was `auto`.

quality.description: (GPT only) The quality tier actually applied.

background.description: (GPT only) The background setting actually applied.

output_format.description: The output format actually applied; for Gemini, derived from the mimeType.

partial_image_index.description: Present only in `partial_image` events. Preview index, starting at 0.

usage.description: Present only in `completed` events. Same structure as the non-streaming `usage`.

ImageGenerationFormRequest.description: Multipart form for the Image Generation API. Same fields as the JSON body, except image inputs are uploaded as files.

image.description: Reference/source image file. Providing an image enters edit mode. For multiple reference images, use the `image[]` field instead.

image[].description: Multiple reference image files, combined by the model. Per-model limits apply.

mask.description: (GPT only) Mask image file (PNG matching the input size). Transparent areas are repainted. Effective only when an image is provided.

VideoGenerationRequest.description: JSON request body for the Video Generation API.

prompt.description: The text description of the video.

duration.description: Video length in seconds. When omitted, the model default applies.

resolution.description: Output resolution. When omitted, the model default applies.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio. `adaptive` lets the model follow the input. When omitted, the model default applies.

frame_images.description: Images to use as the first and last frames of the video.

input_references.description: Reference images that guide generation without locking specific frames.

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate audio along with the video.

seed.description: Random seed, for more reproducible results.

extra_params.description: Vendor-specific parameters, passed through to the upstream model without validation. Keys that duplicate a unified parameter, or that control upstream storage, notification, sample count, or platform behavior, are rejected.

frame_type.description: Whether the image is the first or the last frame.

VideoUsage.description: Metering for the task. Present only when `status` is `completed`.

input_image_count.description: Number of input images, returned when images were supplied.

id.description: Unique task id, used to download the video.

model.description: The model used for this task.

created.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the task was created.

id.description: Unique task id, used to download the video.

model.description: The model used for this task.

created.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the task was created.

video_url.description: Signed download URL for the video file, present when `status` is `completed`. Valid for 7 days after generation.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when `video_url` expires. Present when `status` is `completed`.

duration.description: Length of the generated video in seconds. Present when `status` is `completed`.

resolution.description: Resolution of the generated video. Present when `status` is `completed`.

code.description: Machine-readable failure code, present when `status` is `failed`.

GroundedGenerationRequest.description: Request body for the Grounded Generation API.

modality.description: The type of output to generate.

prompt.description: The text description of what to generate.

model.description: The model to use. When omitted, the model default applies.

duration.description: Video length in seconds. Applies when `modality` is `video`. Values outside the allowed range are adjusted to the nearest bound.

generation_id.description: Unique task id, used to retrieve the result.

modality.description: The type of output this task generates.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the task was created.

modality.description: The type of output this task generates.

output_url.description: Signed download URL for the output, present when `status` is `succeeded`. Requires no API key, and is valid for 7 days after the task was created.

references.description: The reference material used to generate the output.

search_results.description: The search results the references were selected from, grouped by query.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the task was created.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the task was last updated.

GroundedGenerationReference.description: A single piece of reference material.

source_id.description: Identifier of the reference, such as `source1`.

GroundedGenerationSearchGroup.description: The results for one search query.

query.description: The query the task searched for.

source_page.description: URL of the original page hosting the media.

GroundedGenerationError.description: Failure reason, present when `status` is `failed`. Failed tasks are not billed.

code.description: Machine-readable failure code. `MM_GENERATION_CONTENT_POLICY`: the prompt triggered a content policy; `MM_GENERATION_INPUT_IMAGE_PRIVACY_BLOCKED`: the reference material was blocked for privacy; `MM_GENERATION_CONTENT_NOT_SUPPORTED`: the content is not supported; `MM_GENERATION_NO_REFERENCE_MATERIAL`: no usable reference material was found; `MM_GENERATION_REJECTED`: the model rejected the request; `MM_GENERATION_TIMEOUT`: generation timed out, retry; `MM_GENERATION_FAILED`: generation failed for another reason, retry.

GroundedGenerationUsage.description: Metering for the task. Present only when `status` is `succeeded`.

image_count.description: Number of images generated. Returned when `modality` is `image`.

video_count.description: Number of videos generated. Returned when `modality` is `video`.

video_seconds.description: Length of the generated video in seconds. Returned when `modality` is `video`.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer token used for request authentication. Alternatively, you can send the API key in the `x-api-key` header. Note: A payment method is required to use the API.

apiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
apiKeyAuth.description: API key used for request authentication. Alternatively, you can send the key as a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Note: A payment method is required to use the API.

bearerAuthNoPayment.description: Bearer token used for request authentication. Alternatively, you can send the API key in the `x-api-key` header.

apiKeyAuthNoPayment.name: x-api-key
apiKeyAuthNoPayment.description: API key used for request authentication. Alternatively, you can send the key as a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.
